reason: RAC (Recovery Audit Contractor) expansion bills historically function as regulatory capture vectors—outsourcing collection enforcement to private firms with contingency-fee incentives, creating perverse incentives to deny/claw back legitimate claims. Medicaid RAC authority is a known fiscal-bleed mechanism that increases administrative burden on providers while protecting contractor margins.
vectors: regulatory_capture: private contractor safe harbors and fee-sharing structures
fiscal_bleed: contingency-model RACs incentivized to maximize clawbacks regardless of legitimate claim status
entitlement_erosion: RAC operations historically reduce net Medicaid reimbursement through aggressive recoupment
provider_market_access: carve-out for specific RAC firms or contract holders
title: Medicaid RAC Improvement Act of 2026
